title: Algerian-Style Tagine with Caramelized Spring Onions
description: A traditional Algerian dish with a sweet and savory twist. The caramelized spring onions add a depth of flavor to the rich tagine sauce.
instructions: In a large skillet, caramelize the spring onions over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Once caramelized, set the onions aside.
In the same skillet, heat the tagine sauce over medium heat.
Add the caramelized onions to the tagine sauce and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve the tagine sauce over a bed of greens, garnished with additional caramelized onions and a drizzle of sauce.
Optional: sprinkle with sugar for added sweetness.
